system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: Lp(a)HORIZON NCT04023552 - Assessing the Impact of Lipoprotein (a) Lowering With Pelacarsen (TQJ230) on Major Cardiovascular Events in Patients With CVD
Investigational drug: pelacarsen
Document: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04023552 Lp(a)HORIZON (registry, published 2019-07-17, source ctgov:NCT04023552)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT04023552 (Lp(a)HORIZON)
Title: Assessing the Impact of Lipoprotein (a) Lowering With Pelacarsen (TQJ230) on Major Cardiovascular Events in Patients With CVD
Official title: A Randomized Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Trial Assessing the Impact of Lipoprotein (a) Lowering With Pelacarsen (TQJ230) on Major Cardiovascular Events in Patients With Established Cardiovascular Disease
Sponsor: Novartis Pharmaceuticals
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Cardiovascular Disease and Lipoprotein(a)
Interventions: TQJ230 (DRUG); Placebo (DRUG)
Start date: 2019-12-12
Enrollment: 8323 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Time to first occurrence of clinical endpoint committee confirmed expanded major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with elevated Lp(a) ≥ 70 mg/dL [approximately 4 years] | Time to the first occurrence of clinical endpoint committee confirmed expanded major adverse cardiovascular events in a population of patients with elevated Lp(a) ≥ 90 mg/dL. [approximately 4 years]
Eligibility criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria

* Lp(a) ≥ 70 mg/dL at the screening visit, measured at the Central laboratory
* Myocardial infarction: ≥ 3 months from screening and randomization to ≤ 10 years prior to the screening visit
* Ischemic stroke: ≥ 3 months from screening and randomization to ≤ 10 years prior to the screening visit
* Clinically significant symptomatic peripheral artery disease

Key Exclusion Criteria

* Uncontrolled hypertension
* Heart failure New York Heart Association (NYHA) class IV
* History of malignancy of any organ system
* History of hemorrhagic stroke or other major bleeding
* Platelet count ≤LLN
* Active liver disease or hepatic dysfunction
* Significant kidney disease
* Pregnant or nursing women

Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria may apply at the end.
Brief summary: This is a pivotal phase 3 study designed to support an indication for the reduction of cardiovascular risk in patients with established CVD and elevated Lp(a)
Overall status: COMPLETED
Why stopped: -
Primary completion: 2026-07-16
Has posted results: False
--- END ---
